title: Snowball
body:
Description

Snowball is a previously unreleased tool that was first featured in the first Oaklands trailer. For 5 days before Christmas, the testing place map was covered in snow, and playtesters could find little lumps on the ground, that when interacted, would yield a Snowball. It did not have any functionality. However, during the 2024 Christmas Event, it came back in the form of berries that grew on bushes. It could be sold for 125 snowflakes or be grabbed and moved as an item. It remains in the Snowy Peaks/Snowlands region.

Trivia

  • It is the first spherical loose object added to the game.
  • On the 7th of January 2023, in a casual game of pool, Hoofer cheated and still didn't score the ball.
